tours.name: Paris City Tour
tours.description: Experience the magic of Paris with our comprehensive city tour. Visit iconic landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and more. Enjoy authentic French cuisine and explore charming neighborhoods.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival in Paris. Hotel check-in and guided city orientation. Evening Seine River cruise.
Day 2: Eiffel Tower and Trocadéro viewing. Lunch at a local bistro. Visit Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées.
Day 3: Louvre Museum tour. Explore Latin Quarter. Evening stroll through Montmartre.
Day 4: Versailles Palace day trip. Explore gardens and royal chambers.
Day 5: Free time for shopping and last-minute sightseeing. Departure.

tours.name: Tokyo Adventure
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant culture of Tokyo. From ancient temples to cutting-edge technology, experience the perfect blend of traditional and modern Japan.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrive in Tokyo. Traditional tea ceremony. Visit Senso-ji Temple.
Day 2: Shibuya Crossing and shopping. Meiji Shrine. Harajuku district exploration.
Day 3: Imperial Palace East Gardens. Ginza luxury shopping district.
Day 4: Day trip to Mount Fuji and Lake Hakone.
Day 5: Tsukiji Outer Market food tour. Robot Restaurant show.
Day 6: Asakusa cultural district. Skytree Tower visit.
Day 7: Free time and departure.

tours.name: Bali Beach Escape
tours.description: Relax on pristine beaches and explore Bali's rich cultural heritage. Perfect for beach lovers and adventure seekers alike.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrive in Denpasar. Transfer to beach resort. Welcome dinner on the beach.
Day 2: Beach day with water sports activities. Traditional Balinese massage.
Day 3: Ubud cultural tour. Rice terraces and traditional villages.
Day 4: Snorkeling at Coral Triangle. Underwater photography.
Day 5: Temple visits and hiking. Sunset at Mount Batur.
Day 6: Last-minute shopping and departure.

tours.name: New York Metropolis
tours.description: Explore the city that never sleeps. Experience Broadway, world-class museums, iconic landmarks, and incredible food.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrive in NYC. Times Square and Broadway theater show. Welcome dinner.
Day 2: Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island tour. 9/11 Memorial.
Day 3: Central Park walk. Metropolitan Museum of Art. SoHo shopping district.
Day 4: Empire State Building. Fifth Avenue. Departure.

tours.name: Swiss Alps Explorer
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of the Swiss Alps. Perfect for nature lovers and hiking enthusiasts.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrive in Zurich. Transfer to Interlaken.
Day 2: Jungfrau region high-altitude train. Alpine meadows hiking.
Day 3: Lauterbrunnen Valley exploration. Waterfall hikes.
Day 4: Zermatt and Matterhorn views. Mountain photography.
Day 5: Gornergrat mountain railway. Riffelsee lake hiking.
Day 6: Lucerne city tour and lake cruise.
Day 7: Chocolate factory visit. Swiss culture experience.
Day 8: Departure.

tours.name: Dubai Luxury Experience
tours.description: Experience the luxury and glamour of Dubai. Shop, relax, and explore one of the world's most modern cities.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrive in Dubai. Burj Khalifa visit. Downtown Dubai exploration.
Day 2: Dubai Mall and luxury shopping. Fountain show.
Day 3: Desert safari with BBQ dinner. Camel ride.
Day 4: Palm Jumeirah beach day. Water sports activities.
Day 5: Gold Souk visit. Departure.

tours.name: Barcelona Mediterranean
tours.description: Discover the architectural marvels and vibrant culture of Barcelona. From Gaudí's masterpieces to Mediterranean beaches.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrive in Barcelona. Sagrada Familia visit. Gothic Quarter walk.
Day 2: Park Güell exploration. Montjuïc mountain tour.
Day 3: Beach day and seafood dinner. Las Ramblas stroll.
Day 4: Camp Nou stadium tour. Departure.

tours.name: London Heritage Tour
tours.description: Explore Britain's capital with its rich history, royal palaces, museums, and iconic landmarks.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrive in London. Tower of London tour. Welcome dinner.
Day 2: Buckingham Palace and Westminster Abbey.
Day 3: British Museum and gallery visits.
Day 4: Day trip to Stonehenge and Windsor Castle.
Day 5: Thames River cruise. Departure.

tours.name: Greece Island Hopping
tours.description: Island-hop through the stunning Greek islands. Experience pristine beaches, ancient ruins, and authentic Greek hospitality.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrive in Athens. Acropolis tour. Old city exploration.
Day 2: Ferry to Mykonos. Beach relaxation.
Day 3: Delos ruins day trip. Sunset sailing.
Day 4: Ferry to Santorini. Caldera views.
Day 5: Akrotiri archaeological site. Wine tasting.
Day 6: Paros island visit. Beach time.
Day 7: Return to Athens. Departure.

tours.name: Thailand Cultural Journey
tours.description: Immerse yourself in Thai culture. From Bangkok's vibrant street life to ancient temples and tropical islands.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrive in Bangkok. Grand Palace tour. Temple visits.
Day 2: Floating markets. Traditional cooking class.
Day 3: Day trip to Ayutthaya ancient capital.
Day 4: Train to Chiang Mai. Temple visits.
Day 5: Elephant sanctuary and jungle trekking.
Day 6: Return to Bangkok. Departure.
